title: UO+ particles: defaults off, persistence, biomes, density, bounded work and motion

steps.say: Check the non-parity UO+ ambient particle contract without game data.

do.text: Three default-off toggles persist, native swamp/forest/sand and foliage classify, roofs/wet/unknown suppress, density thins emitters, emission/sample caps hold, independent toggles and deterministic time-based motion pass. Synthetic render proof separately checks visibility and disabled zero-pixel difference; live shard world occlusion is not proven by this contract.
